title: Aerealith Service Generator
description: Generate a production-ready Aerealith backend service.

name.title: Service name
name.description: Name of the service. The value is normalized to kebab-case.

description.title: Service description
description.description: Short description of the service's responsibility.

nodePort.title: Node.js port
nodePort.description: TCP port used by the Node.js runtime.

x-prompt.message: Which port should the Node.js service use?

routePrefix.title: API route prefix
routePrefix.description: Optional API route prefix. Leave empty to use /api/V1/services/<service-name>.

x-prompt.message: Custom API route prefix? Leave empty to use the generated default.

frontendUrl.title: Frontend URL
frontendUrl.description: Frontend origin used by the service configuration.

x-prompt.message: What is the production frontend URL?

enableWorker.title: Cloudflare Worker
enableWorker.description: Whether this service should include Cloudflare Worker support.

enableObservability.title: Observability
enableObservability.description: Whether the generated service should enable Aerealith observability.

enableFlagship.title: Feature flags
enableFlagship.description: Whether the Cloudflare Worker should include the Aerealith Flagship binding.
